components.name: Primary Button

components.name: Outline Button

components.name: Ghost Button

components.css: .ds-btn-ghost { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 8px; height: 36px; padding: 0 12px; background: transparent; color: #6C7589; font-family: 'IBM Plex Sans', system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 14px; font-weight: 500; border: none; border-radius: 6px; cursor: pointer; transition: background 150ms, color 150ms; } .ds-btn-ghost:hover { background: #171D2B; color: #E6EBEF; } .ds-btn-ghost:focus-visible { outline: none; box-shadow: 0 0 0 2px #070A13, 0 0 0 4px #F3B416; }

components.css: .ds-input-wrap { display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 6px; } .ds-input-label { font-family: 'IBM Plex Sans', system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 12px; font-weight: 500; color: #6C7589; } .ds-input-prefix-wrap { display: flex; align-items: center; position: relative; } .ds-input-prefix { position: absolute; left: 10px; font-family: 'IBM Plex Mono', ui-monospace, monospace; font-size: 13px; color: #6C7589; pointer-events: none; } .ds-input { width: 100%; height: 40px; padding: 0 12px 0 24px; background: transparent; border: 1px solid #222939; border-radius: 6px; color: #E6EBEF; font-family: 'IBM Plex Sans', system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 14px; outline: none; transition: border-color 150ms, box-shadow 150ms; } .ds-input::placeholder { color: #6C7589; } .ds-input:hover { border-color: #3A4560; } .ds-input:focus { border-color: #F3B416; box-shadow: 0 0 0 2px rgba(243,180,22,0.2); } .ds-input.error { border-color: #DC2828; }

narrative.overview:
This is a calibrated tool, not a dashboard. The SA Retirement Calculator surfaces exact financial projections for users who understand what they're looking at — RA contribution limits, TFSA tax treatment, Monte Carlo success rates, compounding methods. Every element exists to reduce the distance between the user and their number. Nothing decorates; everything informs.

The default theme is dark: deep navy that recedes so the data leads, with a single gold accent that marks the thing that matters — the primary value, the active state, the number you came here for. IBM Plex Sans and IBM Plex Mono carry the voice: technical, neutral, precise. The monospace logotype sets the register immediately — this is a calculation environment, not a consumer app.

This system explicitly rejects the cheerful nudge-culture of consumer fintech (Mint, PocketSmith), the navy-and-gold SaaS cliché with hero metric gradients and identical icon-card grids, and the corporate beige stiffness of bank and insurance portals.
keyCharacteristics: Dark-first, Vault Black background with tonal surface layering (no shadows as structure)
Single accent: Analyst Gold, used sparingly — active states, primary values, key CTAs only
IBM Plex Sans body + IBM Plex Mono for the logotype, metric values, and code-adjacent labels
Component chrome is minimal (borders over fills, ghost hover states, no cards-in-cards)
Data visualization carries the visual weight; UI elements step back
Both dark and light themes meet WCAG AA independently

rules.name: The One Signal Rule
rules.body: Analyst Gold is used on ≤1 active element per view at a time. Applying it to multiple concurrent elements breaks the signal.

rules.name: The Mono Reserve Rule
rules.body: IBM Plex Mono is reserved for financial output values and the wordmark. Not for UI labels or prose.

rules.name: The Tonal Stack Rule
rules.body: Never exceed three tonal steps in a single view hierarchy (page → card → metric card). Nested bg-card is prohibited.

dos: Do use Analyst Gold on exactly one active element per view. Rarity is authority.
Do use IBM Plex Mono for formatted financial values (currency, percentages) and the wordmark.
Do layer depth tonally: Vault Black → Surface Dark → Surface Raised. Three steps maximum.
Do use ghost or outline button variants for secondary actions when a primary is already present.
Do use text-wrap: balance on Display and Headline headings.
Do verify muted foreground text (Ghost Text #6C7589) at 4.5:1 contrast against its background.
Do label every chart series with a text label or legend entry — color alone does not carry information.
Do respect SA-specific account type labels (RA, TFSA, Pension Fund, Preservation Fund) exactly.
donts: Don't nest bg-card inside bg-card — use bg-muted or bg-accent for inner surfaces.
Don't use border-left or border-right greater than 1px as a colored accent stripe on cards.
Don't apply gradient text (background-clip: text with a gradient).
Don't use IBM Plex Mono for UI labels, navigation, or prose copy.
Don't use Analyst Gold on more than one concurrent element.
Don't create a fourth tonal depth step.
Don't use consumer-fintech UI patterns: no gamified progress bars, no pastel metric cards.
Don't use the hero-metric template: large number + small label + gradient accent.
Don't genericise SA account type names for 'clarity'.
